name: @mulbu/dsh-odospace
description: Odospace panel bridge as a Harness plugin: renders dsh task progress and relays AIDA64 frames over the Odospace protocol, with a live panel page in the Web UI.

meta.title: Odospace Panel
meta.description: Renders dsh task progress as a JPEG panel and pushes it to an Odospace client (old phone Remote Panel, ESP32 screen), relaying AIDA64 frames on its own page. Ships a live panel preview page in the Web UI.
